statement: If a 045e:028e-like controller is realized as standard HID Game Pad via UHID, Linux generic HID usage mapping and normal SDL Linux-event/generic mappings may accept its inputs; this alone neither binds kernel USB xpad nor proves SDL hidapi Xbox360 XUSB decoder was selected. Selection requires observed interface/type/backend and report bytes; synthetic XUSB 00 14 data cannot simply be fed into an unrelated generic HID descriptor.
